description: Fallback: the pure math-preserving systems bundle. Run it only if the cut-stack idea fails its offline gate. Base: E069. Apply both verified bit-identical savings together and nothing else: E078's fused per-epoch augment, which writes only consumed samples with an unchanged RNG stream (max diff 2.4e-7), and E077's build()-time warmups (synthetic cuSOLVER/cuBLAS whitening-fit warmup, allocator pre-reservation for the data and augment buffers, pinned staging buffer with non_blocking H2D). Offline, require seeds 0-2 per-seed accuracy bit-identical to E069 (0.7578/0.7535/0.7569) and seeds 3-12 equal to E069's stored results, then launch once. Do not re-roll if it misses: the true mean equals E069's (~0.753), so the local gate is a coin flip, and selecting on reruns would select on noise. If it misses, carry this code into every later candidate as the base.
